lore: Thousands of khom loi drift over the Ping River during Yi Peng. Doi Suthep watches from the mountain above the old city.

Mueang Chiang Mai.note: Brick gates and moat of the old walled city.

Chom Thong.note: Doi Inthanon, Thailand's highest peak at 2,565 m.

San Kamphaeng.note: Bo Sang village paints its famous paper and cotton umbrellas here.

Mae Taeng.note: Elephant camps and sanctuaries along the Mae Taeng valley.

Fang.note: Fang valley is known for its Sai Nam Phueng oranges.

Chiang Dao.note: Chiang Dao Cave, under the limestone peak of Doi Chiang Dao.
